analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹532 crore and EBITDA of ₹89 crore for Q1 FY27 despite raw material constraints and geopolitical disruptions in West Asia. The company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes with 43% utilization in NPK-DAP and 121% utilization in SSP. Management noted a recovery in monsoon activity in early July, which stimulated fertilizer demand after a sluggish start to the Kharif season. The company expects to achieve over ₹500 crore in quarterly turnover in the remaining quarters of FY27 as capacity ramps up. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY increase in Q1 FY27 revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve 30% to 35% revenue growth over the previous year.
guidance.quote: So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach a quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The combined operational capacity of NPK-DAP and SSP supports a revenue potential exceeding ₹500 crore per quarter.
guidance.quote: The revenue potential of over ₹500 crore per quarter is based on the combined capacity of our NPK-DAP and SSP operations.

guidance.claim: The company hopes to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover compared to last year during the remaining quarters.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver overall revenue growth of around 40% including trading and manufacturing during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that margins will be under pressure and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.
guidance.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

guidance.claim: Management expects the benefits of the recent capacity expansion to meaningfully reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
guidance.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

demand_outlook.claim: National Kharif sowing dropped 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares by the end of June due to a nearly 40% rainfall deficit.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Improved monsoon activity in early July led to a recovery in sowing and accelerated fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry-wide production fell 28% year-on-year during April-May 2026, while SSP production declined around 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: By 2030, India will need to feed ~1.7 billion people, sharply raising pressure on the food system.
demand_outlook.quote: By 2030, India will need to feed ~1.7 billion people, sharply raising pressure on the food system.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure, and even if demand were to soften, imports would absorb the impact first.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable because reservoir, river, and borewell water levels are higher compared to earlier periods.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods in the country. Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will purchase green ammonia from a third-party capacity via an arrangement with the Government of India Department of Fertilizer.
capex_expansion.quote: See this capacity of green ammonia is of a third-party capacity and we will buy this green ammonia with an arrangement from the Government of India, Department of Fertilizer one thing.

capex_expansion.claim: The green ammonia capacity is set to start in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are contributing progressively to operational performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stands at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA grew 36% year-on-year to ₹89 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin stands at 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing operations.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25% to 30% of raw material cost increases through subsidy support and price revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation reached ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore due to newly commissioned capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices climbed from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost raw material inventory carried forward from the previous quarter benefited Q1 EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input cost trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating a higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity by 165,000 MT, raising total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Quarterly sales volumes were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volume during the quarter was 21,000 MT.
The company has an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT for the quarter driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production reached 397,263 MT, supported by high demand across markets.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: • Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash collections exceeded ₹700 crore during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Regarding collection of Rs. 700 crore. Because last quarter the debtors was around Rs. 300 crore. Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: The phosphatic industry faced headwinds from supply chain disruptions, high input costs, and geopolitical instability in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia and threats around the Strait of Hormuz created uncertainty in global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary operational bottleneck during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable for the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: Given the industry's reliance on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates, global price movements have a direct impact on the cost structure.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.
